title: 5.0.1 Update
description: Reset a forgotten password, keep pictures in duplicated strategies, and fixes for folders, sharing and large libraries.

changes.message: Forgot your password? Choose Forgot password when you sign in and we'll email you a link to set a new one. If you signed up with Discord, use the same link to add a password and sign in with email too.
Lineup videos play from every common YouTube link, including youtube.com/watch and Shorts links. Before, only youtu.be links played.
The installer asks whether to open Icarus when it finishes.
A duplicated strategy keeps its pictures. Before, the copy showed "Image unavailable", and deleting the original removed the pictures for good.
Deleting a folder now deletes the folders and strategies inside it, as the dialog says. Folders that earlier deletes left hidden show up again at the top of your library.
A broken shared strategy or folder can no longer stop your cloud library from loading.
Icarus tells you as soon as your cloud session stops being accepted, instead of showing Synced.
Signing up with an email that already has an account tells you to sign in instead.
Undo removes a Ctrl-drag copy in one step, instead of leaving a hidden copy behind.
Your default map theme stays set when you change another setting.
Pictures on strategies use far less memory, and big libraries, folders and lineup pages open and save faster.
Editing a page with teammates uses less data while you drag.
Security and privacy fixes for image file names, the updater, and the avatars other people's apps can see.
